name: Newberg Education Foundation
description: A backbone nonprofit that funds and coordinates programs supporting Newberg-area students, including outreach social workers in schools, the student-led Tiger Manufacturing business at Newberg High School, and scholarship and community grant funds.
registrationNote: Appears to be an independently registered nonprofit (Candid lists EIN 94-3250882) but was not found in the directory's existing-names list; may have been missed by the BMF extract or filed under a different address.

name: Yoop! Youth Opportunity Program
description: A program providing tutoring, job-skill building, GED/diploma completion help, internships and career-pathway services for Yamhill County youth ages 16-24 who face barriers such as dropping out, homelessness, foster care involvement or parenthood, with skill centers in McMinnville and Newberg.
registrationNote: Program of Chehalem Youth & Family Services (already in directory); not a separately registered organization.

name: YO Berg / YO Mac Youth Drop-In Centers
description: Drop-in centers and related services (YO Berg emergency shelter for ages 11-17, YO Mac transitional living/drop-in for ages 18-24, and street outreach) for homeless and at-risk youth, with locations in Newberg and McMinnville.
registrationNote: Program of Yamhill Community Action Partnership (already in directory); not a separately registered organization.

name: Cub Scout Pack 454
description: A Cub Scout pack serving kindergarten through 5th-grade children in McMinnville with weekly den meetings focused on camping, service and STEM activities.
parentOrg: First Baptist Church, McMinnville (BSA charter organization) / Scouting America - Cascade Pacific Council
registrationNote: Unincorporated Scouting America unit chartered to a local church; not separately registered with the IRS.

name: Sheridan Scouting Units (Pack 215 / Troop 215 / Troop 9215)
description: Local Scouting America units serving Sheridan-area children and teens: Cub Scout Pack 215 (ages 5-10, founded 1990) and linked Boy/Girl Scout Troops 215 and 9215 (ages 11-17), all meeting weekly in Sheridan.
registrationNote: Unincorporated Scouting America units with local charter organizations; not separately registered with the IRS.

name: Scouting America Troop 9265 / 7265 (Newberg)
description: Girl and boy Scout troops serving Newberg-area teens, sponsored by the local American Legion post; produces Eagle Scouts and runs regular troop meetings and outdoor activities.
parentOrg: American Legion Lester C. Rees Post 57, Newberg / Scouting America - Cascade Pacific Council
registrationNote: Unincorporated Scouting America unit chartered to the local American Legion post; not separately registered with the IRS.

name: Yamhill Early Learning Hub
description: A collaborative program connecting Yamhill County families with young children to child care referrals, free preschool programs, parent classes and early-childhood resources, bringing together early education, health, and social-service partners.
registrationNote: Program of Yamhill Community Care, a coordinated care organization; not separately registered as its own nonprofit.
